source: Ajuntament de Barcelona, Arbres d'interes local (the designated singular-tree register, not the street inventory)
licence_proof: Portal metadata: license_title 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0', license_id 'CC-BY-4.0'.
scope: 208 trees designated of local interest by the city. Catalonia's regional register barely covers Barcelona, so here the city is the authoritative source, the reverse of the Portuguese pattern.
caveat: Two checks per entry before anything ships. Ownership is recorded for part of the list and some read 'Privat', which hard rule 10 blocks unless the ground is genuinely open to visitors. Some entries are ensembles with a Unitats count above one and must pass the collectible-point test. Planting years are the register's own and are not independently verified.
